items.promptZh: 在浮层背后加一层遮罩：铺满屏幕、前景色约 40% 透明度。想清楚点遮罩是否关闭浮层，显示期间锁住页面滚动。

fetch.value: Put a scrim behind the overlay: a fixed full-screen layer in foreground color at about 40% opacity. Decide whether clicking it closes the overlay, and lock page scroll while it shows.

items.name: Segmented control
items.description: A compact row of options where exactly one is on, used to switch a view or a value.
items.descriptionZh: 一排紧凑的互斥选项，只能选中一个，用来切换视图或取值。
items.prompt: Use a segmented control with two to five short options and exactly one selected, for example Day / Week / Month. It changes a value on the same view; use tabs when each option owns its own panel.
items.promptZh: 用分段控件放二到五个短选项、只选一个，例如日 / 周 / 月。它改的是同一视图里的取值；每个选项各有一块面板时用标签页。

fetch.value: Use a segmented control with two to five short options and exactly one selected, for example Day / Week / Month. It changes a value on the same view; use tabs when each option owns its own panel.

items.name: Navigation menu
items.description: The site-level links that take a person to other pages, sometimes opening a panel of sub-links.
items.descriptionZh: 站点级的一组链接，去往其他页面，有时展开一块子链接面板。
items.prompt: Build a navigation menu inside <nav> with real links, aria-current on the active page, and an optional panel of sub-links that opens on click or focus. It changes the page; tabs change a panel on the same page.
items.promptZh: 在 <nav> 里做导航菜单，用真实链接，当前页带 aria-current，可选一块点击或聚焦展开的子链接面板。它换的是页面；标签页换的是同页面板。

fetch.value: Build a navigation menu inside <nav> with real links, aria-current on the active page, and an optional panel of sub-links that opens on click or focus. It changes the page; tabs change a panel on the same page.

items.name: Command palette
items.description: A keyboard-first box that opens over everything and runs an action or jumps somewhere by typing.
items.descriptionZh: 按快捷键浮在一切之上的输入框，打几个字就执行操作或跳转。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab command-palette for a ⌘K palette with a fuzzy filter, grouped results and arrow-key navigation. A combobox picks a value for one field; a command palette runs actions.
items.promptZh: 要 ⌘K 命令面板、模糊过滤、分组结果和方向键选择，安装 UI Lab 的 command-palette。可输入下拉是给一个字段选值，命令面板是执行操作。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab command-palette for a ⌘K palette with a fuzzy filter, grouped results and arrow-key navigation. A combobox picks a value for one field; a command palette runs actions.

items.name: Banner
items.description: A full-width strip at the top or bottom of the page that stays until it is dismissed.
items.descriptionZh: 贴在页面顶部或底部的通栏，一直在，直到被关掉。
items.prompt: Add a full-width banner at the top of the page for a site-wide notice, with one short sentence, an optional link and a close button. It persists across pages; an alert sits inside content and a toast disappears on its own.
items.promptZh: 在页面顶部加一条通栏通知横幅：一句短话、可选链接和关闭按钮。它跨页面一直在；警示块待在内容里，轻提示会自己消失。

fetch.value: Add a full-width banner at the top of the page for a site-wide notice, with one short sentence, an optional link and a close button. It persists across pages; an alert sits inside content and a toast disappears on its own.

items.name: Collapsible
items.description: One block of content with a trigger that shows or hides it.
items.descriptionZh: 一块内容加一个开关，点一下展开或收起。
items.prompt: Use a collapsible for one section: a button with aria-expanded toggles the content below it. Use an accordion when several such sections sit together as a group.
items.promptZh: 单独一块内容用折叠区：带 aria-expanded 的按钮控制下方内容展开收起。好几块并排成组时用折叠面板。

fetch.value: Use a collapsible for one section: a button with aria-expanded toggles the content below it. Use an accordion when several such sections sit together as a group.

items.name: Focus ring
items.description: The outline that shows which control the keyboard is on.
items.descriptionZh: 告诉人键盘现在停在哪个控件上的那圈描边。
items.prompt: Give every interactive element a visible focus ring on :focus-visible, a 2px outline with offset in the theme ring color. Never remove the outline without a replacement.
items.promptZh: 所有可交互元素在 :focus-visible 时显示焦点环：2px 描边加偏移，用主题的 ring 色。不要去掉 outline 却不给替代。

fetch.value: Give every interactive element a visible focus ring on :focus-visible, a 2px outline with offset in the theme ring color. Never remove the outline without a replacement.

items.name: Caret
items.description: The blinking line in a text field where the next character goes. In menus the word also means the small down arrow.
items.descriptionZh: 输入框里一闪一闪、标出下一个字落点的竖线。在菜单里这个词也指那个向下的小箭头。
items.prompt: Style the text caret with caret-color in the primary color. When you mean the small down arrow on a select or menu trigger, say chevron instead of caret.
items.promptZh: 用 caret-color 把输入框插入符设成主色。如果指的是下拉触发器上的小箭头，对 AI 说 chevron，不要说 caret。

fetch.value: Style the text caret with caret-color in the primary color. When you mean the small down arrow on a select or menu trigger, say chevron instead of caret.

items.name: Fade
items.description: Something appears by changing how solid it is.
items.descriptionZh: 东西靠变实在来出现。
items.prompt: Fade the element in with opacity only, on the swift-out curve, and keep it under 300ms. Reduced motion shows the final opacity at once.
items.promptZh: 只用透明度做淡入，走疾出曲线，300 毫秒以内。系统要求减少动效时，直接显示最终透明度。

fetch.value: Fade the element in with opacity only, on the swift-out curve, and keep it under 300ms. Reduced motion shows the final opacity at once.

items.name: Exit
items.description: Something leaves along the same path it used to arrive.
items.descriptionZh: 东西沿进来的那条路离开。
items.prompt: Exit along the entrance path. A fade uses opacity only. A slide uses a short travel plus opacity. Both use the swift-out curve. Reduced motion drops the travel.
items.promptZh: 沿进来的同一条路退出。淡出只用透明度，滑出用短位移加透明度，都走疾出。系统要求减少动效时去掉位移。

fetch.value: Exit along the entrance path. A fade uses opacity only. A slide uses a short travel plus opacity. Both use the swift-out curve. Reduced motion drops the travel.

items.name: Slide in
items.description: Something arrives from a short distance away.
items.descriptionZh: 东西从近处滑到它该在的位置。
items.prompt: Slide the element in with translate and opacity, about 12px of travel, on the swift-out curve. Reduced motion keeps the fade and drops the movement.
items.promptZh: 用位移加透明度滑入，路程大约 12 像素，走疾出曲线。系统要求减少动效时保留淡入，去掉位移。

fetch.value: Slide the element in with translate and opacity, about 12px of travel, on the swift-out curve. Reduced motion keeps the fade and drops the movement.

items.name: Pop in
items.description: Something arrives a little past its size, then settles.
items.descriptionZh: 东西出现时会稍微过一点，再落回该有的大小。
items.prompt: Pop the element in with scale and opacity, letting it pass full size once before it settles. Reduced motion fades it in at scale 1.
items.promptZh: 用缩放加透明度弹入，允许超过完整大小一次再落稳。系统要求减少动效时，以原始大小淡入。

fetch.value: Pop the element in with scale and opacity, letting it pass full size once before it settles. Reduced motion fades it in at scale 1.

items.name: Blur fade
items.description: Something comes into focus as it becomes solid.
items.descriptionZh: 东西变实的同时，从发虚变得清楚。
items.prompt: Bring the element in with opacity, a short rise, and blur of 8px or less. Reduced motion fades it in with no blur and no movement.
items.promptZh: 用透明度、一小段上移和不超过 8 像素的模糊出现。系统要求减少动效时只淡入，不要模糊，也不要位移。

fetch.value: Bring the element in with opacity, a short rise, and blur of 8px or less. Reduced motion fades it in with no blur and no movement.

items.name: Clip reveal
items.description: A cover slides away and the content underneath is uncovered.
items.descriptionZh: 遮罩挪开，底下的内容露出来。
items.prompt: Reveal by animating clip-path from covered to open. The content itself stays still. Reduced motion shows it uncovered.
items.promptZh: 用裁切从盖住变成敞开，内容本身不动。系统要求减少动效时直接敞开。

fetch.value: Reveal by animating clip-path from covered to open. The content itself stays still. Reduced motion shows it uncovered.

items.name: Stagger
items.description: Several things start one after another, a short beat apart.
items.descriptionZh: 好几件东西错开一小拍，一个接一个开始。
items.prompt: Stagger a group by starting each item about 60ms after the previous one. The gap is for order, not for hiding the content. Reduced motion shows the whole group at once.
items.promptZh: 一组东西错峰出现，后一个比前一个晚大约 60 毫秒。这点间隔只为了排出先后，不要把内容藏太久。系统要求减少动效时，整组一起出现。

fetch.value: Stagger a group by starting each item about 60ms after the previous one. The gap is for order, not for hiding the content. Reduced motion shows the whole group at once.

items.name: Press
items.description: A control sinks slightly while a finger is on it.
items.descriptionZh: 手指按着的时候，控件会轻轻陷下去。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab button-base and use Button. The press scale is the spring already in that component.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 button-base，用里面的 Button。按下的缩放用它自带的弹簧。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab button-base and use Button. The press scale is the spring already in that component.

items.name: Magnetic
items.description: A control leans toward the pointer when it comes close.
items.descriptionZh: 指针靠近时，控件会朝指针那边偏一点。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab button-magnetic and use MagneticButton when the control should lean toward the pointer.
items.promptZh: 控件要跟着指针偏的时候，安装 UI Lab 的 button-magnetic，用 MagneticButton。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab button-magnetic and use MagneticButton when the control should lean toward the pointer.

items.name: Tilt
items.description: A card turns in space to follow the pointer.
items.descriptionZh: 卡片随着指针在空间里转一个角度。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab tilt-card and use it for a card that tilts toward the pointer. Keep the tilt on the card, not on the whole page.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 tilt-card，用在要跟着指针倾斜的卡片上。只倾斜这张卡片，不要整页一起转。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab tilt-card and use it for a card that tilts toward the pointer. Keep the tilt on the card, not on the whole page.

items.name: Glare
items.description: A narrow band of light crosses a surface.
items.descriptionZh: 一道窄光从表面扫过去。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab glare-hover and wrap the card. The light band plays when the pointer is over it.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 glare-hover，包住这张卡片。指针在上面时，光带扫过。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab glare-hover and wrap the card. The light band plays when the pointer is over it.

items.name: Ripple
items.description: A ring grows from the place that was pressed.
items.descriptionZh: 从按下的那个点长出一圈。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab button-base and set ripple on Button. The ring grows from the press point, and the press scale stays the button's own spring.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 button-base，给 Button 打开 ripple。圆环从按下的位置长出，按下的缩放仍用按钮自己的弹簧。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab button-base and set ripple on Button. The ring grows from the press point, and the press scale stays the button's own spring.

items.name: Shake
items.description: A field jitters once when the input is rejected.
items.descriptionZh: 输入被拒绝时，这一栏左右抖一下。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab input and pass error when validation fails. The field shakes once and then rests. This is a rejection, not an icon wiggle.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 input。校验失败时传入 error，输入框抖一下后停住。这是拒绝，不是图标的摆动。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab input and pass error when validation fails. The field shakes once and then rests. This is a rejection, not an icon wiggle.

items.name: Swipe to dismiss
items.description: A flick carries a panel off screen and closes it.
items.descriptionZh: 轻轻一甩，面板滑出画面并关掉。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab animated-toast-stack. A toast or panel leaves on a fast flick and returns if the flick is too slow. It leaves along the same side it entered.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 animated-toast-stack。通知或面板甩得够快就离开，不够快就回到原位。离开的一侧和进来的一侧相同。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab animated-toast-stack. A toast or panel leaves on a fast flick and returns if the flick is too slow. It leaves along the same side it entered.

items.name: Drag to reorder
items.description: A grabbed row moves, and the others make a gap for it.
items.descriptionZh: 抓住的那一行跟着走，其余的让出空位。
items.prompt: When a row is dragged, follow the pointer with that row and let the others ease aside with the layout spring. On release it rests in the new order.
items.promptZh: 拖动一行时，这一行跟着指针，其余行用布局弹簧让出空位。松手后停在新的顺序上。

fetch.value: When a row is dragged, follow the pointer with that row and let the others ease aside with the layout spring. On release it rests in the new order.

items.name: Rubber-banding
items.description: Pulling past the edge meets resistance, then snaps back.
items.descriptionZh: 拉过边界时越来越沉，松手后弹回去。
items.prompt: Past the edge, movement shrinks as the pull grows. On release, spring back to the edge. Do not stop hard against an invisible wall.
items.promptZh: 拉过边界后，拉得越远，动得越少。松手后弹回边界。不要在边界上突然停死。

fetch.value: Past the edge, movement shrinks as the pull grows. On release, spring back to the edge. Do not stop hard against an invisible wall.

items.name: Hold to confirm
items.description: A fill completes only while the press is held.
items.descriptionZh: 只有一直按着，确认才会慢慢填满。
items.prompt: While the press is held, fill the confirmation at a constant speed. On release, clear it quickly with the swift-out curve. Keep the press scale separate and small.
items.promptZh: 按住期间用匀速把确认填满。松开时用疾出很快退回。按下的缩放另做，并且很小。

fetch.value: While the press is held, fill the confirmation at a constant speed. On release, clear it quickly with the swift-out curve. Keep the press scale separate and small.

items.name: Check draw
items.description: A check draws itself when the choice turns on.
items.descriptionZh: 选中的时候，对勾把自己画出来。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab checkbox. The check draws in when it turns on, and leaves when it turns off.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 checkbox。勾上时对勾画出来，取消时收回去。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab checkbox. The check draws in when it turns on, and leaves when it turns off.

items.name: Thumb slide
items.description: A thumb slides from one end of a track to the other.
items.descriptionZh: 滑块从轨道这一头滑到那一头。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab switch. The thumb slides along the track when the value changes.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 switch。值改变时，滑块沿轨道滑到另一头。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab switch. The thumb slides along the track when the value changes.

items.name: Pull to refresh
items.description: A pull down the top brings a spinner, then the content settles back.
items.descriptionZh: 从顶上往下拉，转圈出现，然后内容回到原位。
items.prompt: Follow the pull with the content. Show the spinner once the pull passes the threshold, then ease the content back. A short pull returns without refreshing.
items.promptZh: 内容跟着下拉走。拉过阈值才出转圈，然后缓回原位。拉得不够就直接回去，不刷新。

fetch.value: Follow the pull with the content. Show the spinner once the pull passes the threshold, then ease the content back. A short pull returns without refreshing.

items.name: Indeterminate
items.description: A short bar travels along the track while the wait has no end yet.
items.descriptionZh: 还不知道要多久，一段短条在轨道上来回走。
items.prompt: Use a short bar that travels the track and repeats. Fill a bar to the end only when the amount finished is known.
items.promptZh: 还不知道完成了多少时，用一段短条在轨道上走并重复。知道进度时，才让整条填到尽头。

fetch.value: Use a short bar that travels the track and repeats. Fill a bar to the end only when the amount finished is known.

items.name: Text reveal
items.description: Words arrive one after another.
items.descriptionZh: 词一个接一个出现。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab text-reveal and use TextReveal. Split by word for a sentence, by character for a short label.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 text-reveal，用 TextReveal。一句话按词拆，很短的标签按字拆。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab text-reveal and use TextReveal. Split by word for a sentence, by character for a short label.

items.name: Text shimmer
items.description: A light sweeps across the letters.
items.descriptionZh: 一道光从字上扫过。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab text-shimmer and use TextShimmer for a loading or emphasized line.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 text-shimmer，用 TextShimmer 做加载中或需要被看见的一行字。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab text-shimmer and use TextShimmer for a loading or emphasized line.

items.name: Text scramble
items.description: Letters shuffle, then settle into the real word.
items.descriptionZh: 字母先乱跳，再落成要读的那个词。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab text-scramble and use TextScramble. Play it when the text changes or when it enters view.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 text-scramble，用 TextScramble。文字改变时，或进入画面时，再播一次。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab text-scramble and use TextScramble. Play it when the text changes or when it enters view.

items.name: Number ticker
items.description: Each digit rolls into its new place.
items.descriptionZh: 每一位数字滚到新的位置。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab number-ticker and use NumberTicker when each digit should roll. Use tabular numbers so the width stays still.
items.promptZh: 每一位要滚动时，安装 UI Lab 的 number-ticker，用 NumberTicker。数字用等宽，宽度才不会跟着跳。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab number-ticker and use NumberTicker when each digit should roll. Use tabular numbers so the width stays still.

items.name: Count up
items.description: A value counts from where it was to where it is.
items.descriptionZh: 一个数从旧值数到新值。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab animated-number and use AnimatedNumber when the value should count up as one number. For rolling digits, use number-ticker.
items.promptZh: 整个数要往上数时，安装 UI Lab 的 animated-number，用 AnimatedNumber。要每一位分开滚，用 number-ticker。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab animated-number and use AnimatedNumber when the value should count up as one number. For rolling digits, use number-ticker.

items.name: Text cascade
items.description: Old letters drop away as the new ones land.
items.descriptionZh: 旧字母掉下去，新字母落上来。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab text-cascade and use TextCascade when a word changes letter by letter.
items.promptZh: 一个词要逐个字母换成新词时，安装 UI Lab 的 text-cascade，用 TextCascade。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab text-cascade and use TextCascade when a word changes letter by letter.

items.name: Typewriter
items.description: Letters appear one at a time, as if they are being typed.
items.descriptionZh: 字一个一个出现，像正在被打出来。
items.prompt: Reveal a short generated line one character at a time. Keep body copy that is already written fully visible.
items.promptZh: 正在生成的短句按一个字一个字出现。已经写好的正文直接显示全文。

fetch.value: Reveal a short generated line one character at a time. Keep body copy that is already written fully visible.

items.name: Word rotate
items.description: One word slot shows the next word by sliding it into place.
items.descriptionZh: 同一个词位滑出旧词，滑进下一个词。
items.prompt: Keep one word slot. Slide the next whole word into it. Letters that scramble or drop one by one are a different motion.
items.promptZh: 留一个词位，整个词滑进去换成下一个。逐字乱跳或逐字掉落是另外的动效。

fetch.value: Keep one word slot. Slide the next whole word into it. Letters that scramble or drop one by one are a different motion.

items.name: Parallax
items.description: A background drifts slower than the words in front of it.
items.descriptionZh: 背景比前面的字移动得更慢。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab parallax and move only the decorative layer. Leave the heading and the actions in normal flow, and keep a static layer under reduced motion.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 parallax，只移动装饰层。标题和按钮留在正常排版里。系统要求减少动效时，这层保持不动。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab parallax and move only the decorative layer. Leave the heading and the actions in normal flow, and keep a static layer under reduced motion.

items.name: Scroll reveal
items.description: A block appears as it comes into view.
items.descriptionZh: 一块内容进入视线时才出现。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab scroll-reveal and wrap each block that should appear as it enters. Reduced motion keeps a fade.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 scroll-reveal，包住每一块要在进入视线时出现的内容。系统要求减少动效时保留淡入。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab scroll-reveal and wrap each block that should appear as it enters. Reduced motion keeps a fade.

items.name: Scroll progress
items.description: A thin bar shows how far the reading has gone.
items.descriptionZh: 一条细线告诉你这篇已经读到哪里。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab scroll-progress and tie the bar to the reading container. Grow it with scaleX from the left edge.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 scroll-progress，让细条跟着这篇的滚动容器走。从左边缘用 scaleX 变长。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab scroll-progress and tie the bar to the reading container. Grow it with scaleX from the left edge.

items.name: Smooth scroll
items.description: The page eases along instead of jumping with the wheel.
items.descriptionZh: 页面跟着滚轮缓缓走，而不是一下跳一截。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab smooth-scroll and wrap the page in its provider. Reduced motion uses the browser's own scroll.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 smooth-scroll，用它的 provider 包住页面。系统要求减少动效时，用浏览器自己的滚动。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab smooth-scroll and wrap the page in its provider. Reduced motion uses the browser's own scroll.

items.name: Pinned
items.description: A title stays while the notes beside it move on.
items.descriptionZh: 标题留在原处，旁边的说明继续往下走。
items.prompt: Pin the title with position: sticky and a clear top offset inside its own section. Let the notes scroll past it, and stack the columns on a narrow screen.
items.promptZh: 标题用 position: sticky，并在它所在的这一段里写明 top。说明从它旁边滚过去。窄屏改成上下排列。

fetch.value: Pin the title with position: sticky and a clear top offset inside its own section. Let the notes scroll past it, and stack the columns on a narrow screen.

items.name: Stacking cards
items.description: Cards catch up and sit on top of one another.
items.descriptionZh: 后面的卡片追上来，叠在前面的卡片上。
items.prompt: Stack the cards with position: sticky and a slightly larger top on each next card, so every card leaves a visible edge.
items.promptZh: 卡片用 position: sticky，后一张的 top 比前一张多一截，让每一张都露出一条边。

fetch.value: Stack the cards with position: sticky and a slightly larger top on each next card, so every card leaves a visible edge.

items.name: Scroll snap
items.description: A scroll comes to rest on one whole panel.
items.descriptionZh: 滚动会停在一整块面板上。
items.prompt: Use scroll-snap-type: y mandatory on the local container, and scroll-snap-align: start on each panel. Keep the snap inside that container.
items.promptZh: 局部容器用 scroll-snap-type: y mandatory，每一块用 scroll-snap-align: start。吸附留在这个容器里。

fetch.value: Use scroll-snap-type: y mandatory on the local container, and scroll-snap-align: start on each panel. Keep the snap inside that container.

items.name: Horizontal scroll
items.description: A row moves sideways while the page itself stays put.
items.descriptionZh: 这一排往旁边走，页面本身还在原处。
items.prompt: Put the sideways movement in its own row. Let several items stay visible, and keep the page scrolling vertically.
items.promptZh: 横向移动放在它自己的这一排里，同时能看见好几项。页面仍是上下滚动。

fetch.value: Put the sideways movement in its own row. Let several items stay visible, and keep the page scrolling vertically.

items.name: Scroll zoom
items.description: An image grows as the reading moves past it.
items.descriptionZh: 读着往下走，画面跟着变大。
items.prompt: Scale only the image as its section moves through view. Keep the caption still, and stop the zoom under reduced motion.
items.promptZh: 只放大那张图，字幕留在原处。系统要求减少动效时停止放大。

fetch.value: Scale only the image as its section moves through view. Keep the caption still, and stop the zoom under reduced motion.

items.name: Scroll hint
items.description: A small mark keeps pointing downward so the reader knows there is more.
items.descriptionZh: 一个小标记一直往下指，告诉人下面还有。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab scroll-hint and place it at the foot of a hero. It loops until the reader moves on.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 scroll-hint，放在首屏底下。它一直循环，直到读者往下走。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab scroll-hint and place it at the foot of a hero. It loops until the reader moves on.

items.name: Marquee
items.description: A row of items keeps sliding, and the end joins the start.
items.descriptionZh: 一排东西一直滑，尾接上了头。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab marquee and use Marquee for a row that should loop. Pause it when the pointer is over it.
items.promptZh: 一排内容要循环滑下去时，安装 UI Lab 的 marquee，用 Marquee。指针放上去时暂停。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab marquee and use Marquee for a row that should loop. Pause it when the pointer is over it.

items.name: Border light
items.description: A point of light travels around a border.
items.descriptionZh: 一个光点沿着边框走。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab star-border and wrap the control with StarBorder.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 star-border，用 StarBorder 包住这个控件。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab star-border and wrap the control with StarBorder.

items.name: Bounce cards
items.description: A stack of cards springs open into a fan.
items.descriptionZh: 一叠卡片弹开，变成一把扇子。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab bounce-cards and use BounceCards when a stack should spring open into a fan as it enters.
items.promptZh: 一叠卡片进入画面时要弹开成扇形，安装 UI Lab 的 bounce-cards，用 BounceCards。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab bounce-cards and use BounceCards when a stack should spring open into a fan as it enters.

items.name: Magnify
items.description: The item nearest the pointer grows, and the others make room.
items.descriptionZh: 离指针最近的那一项变大，旁边的让出位置。
items.prompt: Grow the item closest to the pointer and let the neighbors ease aside with the layout spring. Reduced motion keeps every item at its resting size.
items.promptZh: 离指针最近的一项放大，旁边的项用布局弹簧让开。系统要求减少动效时，每一项都停在原来的大小。

fetch.value: Grow the item closest to the pointer and let the neighbors ease aside with the layout spring. Reduced motion keeps every item at its resting size.

items.name: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder block waits with a light moving across it.
items.descriptionZh: 内容还没到，占位块上有一道光在走。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab skeleton and use it while content is still loading. Reduced motion replaces the sweep with a calm opacity pulse.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 skeleton，内容还没到时用它。系统要求减少动效时，扫光改成平静的透明度脉冲。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab skeleton and use it while content is still loading. Reduced motion replaces the sweep with a calm opacity pulse.

items.name: Spinner
items.description: A mark turns while work is still going.
items.descriptionZh: 事情还在进行，标记一直转。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab loader and use the spinner variant while a request is in flight.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 loader，请求还没回来时用它的 spinner。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab loader and use the spinner variant while a request is in flight.

items.name: Carousel
items.description: One item fills the frame, then the next item takes its place.
items.descriptionZh: 框里一次放一项，然后换成下一项。
items.prompt: Advance one item at a time until it rests in the frame. A row that never stops is a marquee.
items.promptZh: 一次推进一项，并在框里停住。一直不停滑过去的是走马灯。

fetch.value: Advance one item at a time until it rests in the frame. A row that never stops is a marquee.

items.name: Orbit
items.description: A mark travels in a circle around a center.
items.descriptionZh: 一个标记绕着中心转圈。
items.prompt: Move the mark on a circular path at a constant speed. Keep the center still.
items.promptZh: 标记沿圆周匀速走，中心留在原处。

fetch.value: Move the mark on a circular path at a constant speed. Keep the center still.

items.name: Float
items.description: Something drifts up and down without going anywhere.
items.descriptionZh: 东西轻轻上下浮，并不离开这处。
items.prompt: Drift a few pixels up and down on a repeating ease-in-out. Keep it off controls people use all day.
items.promptZh: 用缓入缓出上下浮几个像素并重复。一天要点很多次的控件不要加这个。

fetch.value: Drift a few pixels up and down on a repeating ease-in-out. Keep it off controls people use all day.

items.name: Confetti
items.description: Small pieces fall and tumble after a success.
items.descriptionZh: 做成一件事之后，碎纸掉下来并翻滚。
items.prompt: Play a short fall of a few pieces after a rare success, then stop. Do not loop it on an everyday screen.
items.promptZh: 少见的成功之后，让几片碎纸落下并翻滚，然后停。日常页面不要一直循环。

fetch.value: Play a short fall of a few pieces after a rare success, then stop. Do not loop it on an everyday screen.

items.name: Beam
items.description: A light travels from one point to another.
items.descriptionZh: 一道光从一个点走到另一个点。
items.prompt: Run a short bright segment along the line that joins the two points, then repeat.
items.promptZh: 让一小段亮光沿着连接两点的线走，然后重复。

fetch.value: Run a short bright segment along the line that joins the two points, then repeat.

items.name: Spotlight
items.description: A pool of light moves across a dark surface.
items.descriptionZh: 一团光在深色表面上移动。
items.prompt: Move a soft radial light across the surface. Leave the content underneath still.
items.promptZh: 让一团柔和的圆光在表面上移动，底下的内容不动。

fetch.value: Move a soft radial light across the surface. Leave the content underneath still.

items.name: Progressive blur
items.description: One edge of a surface is sharp and the other edge dissolves into blur.
items.descriptionZh: 一边清楚，另一边逐渐糊掉。
items.prompt: Blur only toward the edge that meets other content. Keep the part being read sharp.
items.promptZh: 只在和别的内容相接的那一边逐渐模糊。正在读的部分保持清楚。

fetch.value: Blur only toward the edge that meets other content. Keep the part being read sharp.

items.name: Shared layout
items.description: A highlight travels from the old choice to the new one.
items.descriptionZh: 高亮从旧选项滑到新选项。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab shared-layout-bg and use one shared pill for the moving highlight. For tabs, install tabs; the indicator uses the same layout spring.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 shared-layout-bg，用同一块胶囊做滑动的高亮。选项卡安装 tabs，指示条用的是同一档布局弹簧。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab shared-layout-bg and use one shared pill for the moving highlight. For tabs, install tabs; the indicator uses the same layout spring.

items.name: Morph
items.description: One shape turns into the next without being replaced.
items.descriptionZh: 一个形状变成下一个，中间没有被换掉。
items.prompt: Morph by animating the same element from one size and corner radius to the next. Keep the content crossfading inside it.
items.promptZh: 变形时改的是同一个元素的大小和圆角。里面的内容用交叉淡化换掉。

fetch.value: Morph by animating the same element from one size and corner radius to the next. Keep the content crossfading inside it.

items.name: Crossfade
items.description: The old layer fades out while the new one fades in, in the same place.
items.descriptionZh: 旧的一层变淡，新的一层在同一处变实。
items.prompt: Crossfade two layers in the same spot: one opacity falls while the other rises. Keep both layers still.
items.promptZh: 两层待在同一处，一层透明度下降，另一层同时上升。两层都不要挪位。

fetch.value: Crossfade two layers in the same spot: one opacity falls while the other rises. Keep both layers still.

items.name: Origin-aware
items.description: A popover grows from the control that opened it.
items.descriptionZh: 浮层从打开它的那个控件长出来。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab dropdown-menu. The panel grows from the trigger's corner. A dialog stays centered on the screen.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 dropdown-menu。面板从触发它的那个角长出来。对话框仍留在画面中央。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab dropdown-menu. The panel grows from the trigger's corner. A dialog stays centered on the screen.

items.name: Shared element
items.description: One surface travels from a thumbnail into the detail.
items.descriptionZh: 同一块表面从缩略处走到详情。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab expanding-card. The same card grows from its place into the detail, and shrinks back there on close.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 expanding-card。同一张卡片从原位展开成详情，关掉时缩回原处。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab expanding-card. The same card grows from its place into the detail, and shrinks back there on close.

items.name: Direction-aware
items.description: Forward travel leaves one way, and back travel arrives from the other.
items.descriptionZh: 往前走时从一侧离开，返回时从另一侧进来。
items.prompt: Slide forward content off one side, and bring back content in from the opposite side, so the trip has a direction.
items.promptZh: 前进时内容从一侧滑走，返回时从相反的一侧进来，让这次移动有方向。

fetch.value: Slide forward content off one side, and bring back content in from the opposite side, so the trip has a direction.

items.name: Page transition
items.description: The old page leaves and the next page comes in.
items.descriptionZh: 旧页面离开，下一页进来。
items.prompt: When navigating, let the old page leave and the next page enter from the opposite side. Keep the travel short and use the swift-out curve.
items.promptZh: 换页时旧页面离开，下一页从相反一侧进来。路程短，走疾出。

fetch.value: When navigating, let the old page leave and the next page enter from the opposite side. Keep the travel short and use the swift-out curve.

items.name: View transition
items.description: The browser connects the before and after of one view.
items.descriptionZh: 切换前后的同一块被连在一起。
items.prompt: Use a view transition to connect the same element before and after a state change. Keep the element recognizable across the change.
items.promptZh: 状态切换时用视图过渡把前后的同一块连起来，让人认得这还是它。

fetch.value: Use a view transition to connect the same element before and after a state change. Keep the element recognizable across the change.

items.name: Swap
items.description: The old label leaves as the new one takes its place.
items.descriptionZh: 旧文案离开，新文案占上这个位置。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab action-swap-blur and use ActionSwapText for a label that changes in place. Letter-by-letter uses action-swap-cascade. A roll from below uses action-swap-roll.
items.promptZh: 文案要在原地换掉时，安装 UI Lab 的 action-swap-blur，用 ActionSwapText。要逐个字母换，用 action-swap-cascade。要从下面滚上来，用 action-swap-roll。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab action-swap-blur and use ActionSwapText for a label that changes in place. Letter-by-letter uses action-swap-cascade. A roll from below uses action-swap-roll.

items.name: Expand
items.description: A section opens its height and the rest move to make room.
items.descriptionZh: 一块区域把高度打开，其余的让出位置。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab bouncy-accordion and use BouncyAccordion when one section opens and the rows around it move with it.
items.promptZh: 一块要打开、周围的行也跟着让位时，安装 UI Lab 的 bouncy-accordion，用 BouncyAccordion。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab bouncy-accordion and use BouncyAccordion when one section opens and the rows around it move with it.

items.name: Inertia drag
items.description: A panel follows the finger, then coasts to a rest.
items.descriptionZh: 面板跟着手指走，松手后还会滑一段再停下。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab bottom-sheet and use it for a panel that follows the drag and settles on a snap point.
items.promptZh: 面板要跟着拖拽走、再停在吸附点上时，安装 UI Lab 的 bottom-sheet，用它。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab bottom-sheet and use it for a panel that follows the drag and settles on a snap point.

items.name: Drawer slide
items.description: A panel slides in from the side and covers part of the page.
items.descriptionZh: 一块面板从旁边滑入，盖住页面的一部分。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab drawer. The panel slides in from the side on the drawer curve and leaves the same way.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 drawer。面板从旁边沿抽屉曲线滑入，并沿同一边离开。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab drawer. The panel slides in from the side on the drawer curve and leaves the same way.

items.name: Before / after
items.description: A divider wipes between two layers stacked in the same frame.
items.descriptionZh: 一道分隔线在同一框里的两层之间来回擦。
items.prompt: Stack the two images and move one clip from side to side with the divider. The images stay still.
items.promptZh: 两张图叠在一起，只移动裁切和那道分隔线。图本身不动。

fetch.value: Stack the two images and move one clip from side to side with the divider. The images stay still.

items.name: Flip
items.description: A card turns over and shows its other face.
items.descriptionZh: 卡片翻过去，露出另一面。
items.prompt: Turn the card on its vertical axis so the front hides and the back arrives. Keep both faces the same size.
items.promptZh: 绕竖直轴把卡片翻过去，正面让开，背面到达。两面一样大。

fetch.value: Turn the card on its vertical axis so the front hides and the back arrives. Keep both faces the same size.

items.name: Insert
items.description: A new row appears and the rows around it move to make room.
items.descriptionZh: 新的一行出现，旁边的行让出位置。
items.prompt: When a row is added or removed, move the surrounding rows to their new places with the layout spring. The new row fades in.
items.promptZh: 增加或去掉一行时，周围的行用布局弹簧走到新位置。新的一行淡入。

fetch.value: When a row is added or removed, move the surrounding rows to their new places with the layout spring. The new row fades in.

items.name: Ease out
items.description: It starts fast and arrives slowly.
items.descriptionZh: 起步快，停下来的时候慢。
items.prompt: Use the swift-out curve for something entering, opening, or answering a pointer. It starts fast and settles slowly.
items.promptZh: 进场、展开、回应指针时用疾出曲线。起步快，收尾慢。

fetch.value: Use the swift-out curve for something entering, opening, or answering a pointer. It starts fast and settles slowly.

items.name: Ease in-out
items.description: It leaves slowly, crosses quickly, and arrives slowly.
items.descriptionZh: 离开时慢，中间快，到达时又慢。
items.prompt: Use the push-pull curve when something already on screen travels from one place to another.
items.promptZh: 已经在画面上的东西，从一处走到另一处时，用推拉曲线。

fetch.value: Use the push-pull curve when something already on screen travels from one place to another.

items.name: Spring
items.description: It moves like it has weight, and may pass the target once.
items.descriptionZh: 它带着重量走，有时会超过目标再回来。
items.prompt: Use a spring when the motion can be interrupted or should settle with weight. Press uses the button spring. A moving highlight uses the layout spring.
items.promptZh: 动效可能被打断，或需要有重量地停住时，用弹簧。按压用按钮那一档。高亮滑动用布局那一档。

fetch.value: Use a spring when the motion can be interrupted or should settle with weight. Press uses the button spring. A moving highlight uses the layout spring.

items.name: Draw
items.description: A stroke draws itself.
items.descriptionZh: 线条把自己画出来。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant draw. The stroke draws itself with pathLength.
items.promptZh: 安装 UI Lab 的 animated-icon，用 AnimatedIcon，variant 设为 draw。描边用 pathLength 把自己画出来。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant draw. The stroke draws itself with pathLength.

items.name: Wiggle
items.description: An icon shakes once from side to side.
items.descriptionZh: 图标左右摇一下。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant wiggle for a notification icon.
items.promptZh: 通知图标要摇一下时，安装 UI Lab 的 animated-icon，用 AnimatedIcon，variant 设为 wiggle。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant wiggle for a notification icon.

items.name: Spin
items.description: An icon turns one full circle.
items.descriptionZh: 图标转一整圈。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant spin for refresh or sync.
items.promptZh: 刷新或同步要转一圈时，安装 UI Lab 的 animated-icon，用 AnimatedIcon，variant 设为 spin。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant spin for refresh or sync.

items.name: Pulse
items.description: An icon gently grows and shrinks while it waits.
items.descriptionZh: 图标在等待时轻轻变大再变小。
items.prompt: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant pulse for a live or waiting status.
items.promptZh: 在线或等待中的状态要轻轻胀缩时，安装 UI Lab 的 animated-icon，用 AnimatedIcon，variant 设为 pulse。

fetch.value: Install UI Lab animated-icon and use AnimatedIcon with variant pulse for a live or waiting status.

items.name: Centered Column
items.description: Use for blogs, documentation articles, and reading-led marketing pages where one narrative should hold attention.
items.descriptionZh: 适合博客、文档正文和以连续阅读为主的营销页，让一条叙事线始终占据视觉中心。
items.prompt:
Use a Centered Column full-page layout: keep the header and footer full width, constrain the middle reading column to 72ch with margin-inline: auto, and use a vertical flex shell so the content fills the remaining height; only tighten side gutters on mobile.

FORBIDDEN: trapping the header or footer inside the reading measure, allowing unlimited line length, replacing max-width with a fixed pixel width, or keeping oversized mobile gutters.
items.promptZh:
使用「居中单栏 / Centered Column」整页结构：header 与 footer 通栏，中间正文列限制为 72ch，并用 margin-inline: auto 居中；页面外层纵向 flex，正文区填满剩余高度，移动端只收窄左右边距。

FORBIDDEN: 把 header/footer 也锁进正文版心、让正文无限变宽、用固定像素宽度替代 max-width、在移动端保留过大的页边距。

items.name: Sidebar + Content
items.description: Use for admin tools, documentation sites, and application shells with persistent primary navigation.
items.descriptionZh: 适合后台、文档站和带持久主导航的应用外壳。
items.prompt:
Use a Sidebar + Content full-page layout: create a two-column CSS Grid with a fixed 260px navigation rail and a fluid 1fr main area, set min-inline-size: 0 on main, and move navigation into a drawer or top bar on narrow screens.

FORBIDDEN: absolutely positioning the sidebar, fixing the width of both columns, letting long content blow out the grid, or keeping a permanent 260px sidebar on phones.
items.promptZh:
使用「侧栏布局 / Sidebar + Content」整页结构：页面用两列 CSS Grid，左侧导航固定 260px，右侧 main 用 1fr 流式占满，并设置 min-inline-size: 0 防止内容撑破；窄屏把侧栏移入抽屉或顶栏。

FORBIDDEN: 用绝对定位固定侧栏、同时给主区固定宽度、让长内容撑宽网格、在手机上继续常驻 260px 侧栏。

items.name: Holy Grail
items.description: Use for portals and classic web applications that need global chrome plus secondary navigation and contextual content.
items.descriptionZh: 适合门户和经典 Web 应用：既有全局头尾，又需要次级导航与上下文侧栏。
items.prompt:
Use a Holy Grail full-page layout: define named CSS Grid areas for header, nav, main, aside, and footer; span the header and footer across all three columns, keep the center as auto / 1fr / auto, fill at least the viewport, and stack the middle regions in order on narrow screens.

FORBIDDEN: hard-positioning the three columns with absolute coordinates, fixed pixel heights, refusing to collapse on narrow screens, or letting nav and aside steal the main area's width.
items.promptZh:
使用「圣杯布局 / Holy Grail」整页结构：CSS Grid 划分 header、nav、main、aside、footer 五个命名区域，header/footer 横跨三列，中段由自适应宽 nav、1fr 主区和自适应宽 aside 组成，页面至少占满视口；窄屏把中间三列顺序叠放。

FORBIDDEN: 用绝对定位硬摆三栏、固定像素高度、三列在窄屏不塌缩、nav/aside 抢主区宽度。

items.name: Split Screen
items.description: Use for sign-in or registration flows and high-contrast landing pages that pair an action with imagery or a brand field.
items.descriptionZh: 适合登录/注册流程，以及把操作与图片或品牌色块并置的强对比落地页。
items.prompt:
Use a Split Screen full-page layout: fill at least the viewport with two equal CSS Grid columns, place the form or primary message on one side and imagery, illustration, or a brand field on the other, allow both panels to shrink, and stack them on narrow screens.

FORBIDDEN: assembling the halves with absolute positioning, duplicating content across both sides, clipping the primary form to preserve 50/50, or forcing side-by-side panels on phones.
items.promptZh:
使用「双栏分屏 / Split Screen」整页结构：页面用两列等宽 CSS Grid 并至少占满视口，一侧承载表单或核心文案，另一侧承载图片、插画或纯色品牌面；两个 panel 都允许内容收缩，窄屏上下堆叠。

FORBIDDEN: 用 absolute 把两半拼起来、两侧内容重复、为了 50/50 裁掉关键表单、在手机上仍强制并排。

items.name: Three-Pane
items.description: Use for chat, mail, IDE, and Agent applications where global navigation, a browsable list, and focused detail stay visible together. See the complete, product-level version in Design Systems at /layouts.
items.descriptionZh: 适合聊天、邮件、IDE 和 Agent 应用，让全局导航、可浏览列表与详情同时在场；完整血肉版见「设计系统」模块 /layouts。
items.prompt:
Use a Three-Pane workbench layout: define a 64px icon rail, a 320px independently scrolling list, and a fluid 1fr detail or context pane in CSS Grid; pin the workbench to the viewport height with min-block-size: 0 on each pane, then hide the rail and alternate list/detail on narrow screens.

FORBIDDEN: turning the three panes into floating overlays, giving both the page and list competing scroll containers, fixing the detail width, or squeezing all three columns side by side on narrow screens.
items.promptZh:
使用「三栏工作台 / Three-Pane」整页结构：CSS Grid 三列依次为 64px 图标 rail、320px 可独立滚动列表和 1fr 详情/上下文区，工作台固定为视口高度且各列 min-block-size: 0；窄屏隐藏 rail，列表与详情改成二级切换。

FORBIDDEN: 把三栏做成三个浮层、让整个页面和列表同时抢滚动、给详情列固定宽度、在窄屏把三列等比缩小后硬塞并排。

items.name: Dashboard Grid
items.description: Use for analytics back offices, monitoring surfaces, and overview pages made of independent summary widgets.
items.descriptionZh: 适合分析后台、监控面板和由独立摘要组件组成的概览页。
items.prompt:
Use a Dashboard Grid full-page structure: build an adaptive widget grid with repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)) and a 16px gap; let one primary widget span two columns and two rows while smaller metric cards auto-place, then reset the primary widget to one cell on the narrowest screens.

FORBIDDEN: hard-coding a column count at every breakpoint, giving every card equal emphasis, filling holes with absolute positioning, or keeping span 2 on a single-column screen.
items.promptZh:
使用「仪表盘网格 / Dashboard Grid」整页结构：内容区用 auto-fit + minmax(220px, 1fr) 生成自适应卡片网格，间距 16px；一个主 widget 横跨两列两行，其余指标卡自动补位，最窄屏把主卡恢复为单格。

FORBIDDEN: 为每个断点手写固定列数、让所有卡同等强调、用绝对定位填洞、在单列屏保留 span 2 导致溢出。

items.name: List-Detail
items.description: Use for mail, settings, messaging, and any workflow where selecting one item reveals its detail.
items.descriptionZh: 适合邮件、设置、消息，以及任何“选一项看详情”的工作流。
items.prompt:
Use a List-Detail full-page layout: create a 340px independently scrolling list beside a fluid 1fr detail pane in CSS Grid and fill the viewport height; on narrow screens, turn list and detail into two route-level states.

FORBIDDEN: creating competing page/list scroll, fixing the detail width too, squeezing both columns onto phones after selection, or requiring hover to open detail.
items.promptZh:
使用「列表详情 / List-Detail」整页结构：CSS Grid 左侧 340px 列表独立纵向滚动，右侧 1fr 详情面板承载选中项内容，整体占满视口高度；窄屏将列表与详情改成两个路由层级。

FORBIDDEN: 让列表与整页形成双重滚动、把详情也设成固定宽度、选择项后仍在手机上挤出两列、依赖 hover 才能进入详情。

items.name: Full Canvas
items.description: Use for design tools, maps, whiteboards, and node editors where the workspace is primary and controls sit above it.
items.descriptionZh: 适合设计工具、地图、白板和节点编辑器，让工作画布成为主角，控制面板覆盖其上。
items.prompt:
Use a Full Canvas page shell: make a position: relative viewport-height container with overflow hidden, stretch the workspace with absolute inset: 0, float a toolbar at the top left, and dock an approximately 280px inspector on the right with an explicit overlay hierarchy; collapse the inspector into a bottom drawer on narrow screens.

FORBIDDEN: shrinking the canvas with normal document flow, allowing the page itself to scroll, scattering every control into an independent floating window, or keeping a right panel that covers most of the canvas on phones.
items.promptZh:
使用「全屏画布 / Full Canvas」整页结构：外壳 position: relative、占满视口并裁掉溢出，工作画布 absolute inset: 0 全铺；工具条悬浮左上，约 280px 属性面板停靠右侧，覆盖层保持明确层级；窄屏把属性面板收成底部抽屉。

FORBIDDEN: 用普通文档流挤压画布、让页面本身滚动、每个控制都散成独立浮窗、在手机上保留遮住大半画布的右侧面板。

items.name: Parallax
items.description: Give a hero or cover image a restrained sense of depth without moving the reading layer.
items.descriptionZh: 用于 hero 或封面制造克制的景深，同时让正文阅读层保持稳定。
items.prompt:
Use restrained parallax scrolling: move only the hero's decorative background layer against the scroll at roughly 0.35x the foreground speed, while headings, actions, and body copy remain in normal flow. Cap desktop travel at 30% of the container height and provide a static background for reduced motion and mobile.

FORBIDDEN: page-wide parallax, drifting body copy, travel beyond 30%, forced motion on mobile, or fake depth made from aggressive scaling and blur.
items.promptZh:
请使用克制的视差滚动（Parallax Scrolling）：只让 hero 的装饰背景层以约前景 0.35 倍的速度反向位移，标题、按钮和正文保持在正常文档流；桌面端位移幅度控制在容器高度的 30% 内，并为 reduced-motion 与移动端提供静态背景。

FORBIDDEN：整页所有元素都做视差、正文跟着漂移、超过 30% 的大幅位移、移动端强制开启、用缩放或 blur 伪装景深导致眩晕。

items.name: Pinned
items.description: Keep a chapter title or reference visual present while its supporting content passes beside it.
items.descriptionZh: 让章节标题或参考图常驻，同时相关说明在旁边或下方逐段滚过。
items.prompt:
Use a pinned / sticky chapter: place the chapter title panel in the left column and pin it to the top of its local scroll container with position: sticky and an explicit top offset. Let the supporting content stay in normal flow and release the title naturally at the section end; stack the columns on mobile.

FORBIDDEN: fixed positioning that escapes the local container, permanent page-level pinning, pinning both columns, hiding the content scrollbar, or preserving a cramped two-column layout on mobile.
items.promptZh:
请使用钉住式章节（Pinned / Sticky Section）：把章节标题面板放在双列布局左侧，用 position: sticky 和明确的 top 偏移固定在局部滚动容器顶部；右侧内容保持正常文档流，滚过标题后再自然释放，移动端改为上下布局。

FORBIDDEN：用 fixed 脱离局部容器、整页永久吸顶、左右两列都钉住、隐藏正文滚动条、移动端保留拥挤双列。

items.name: Scroll Reveal
items.description: Pace a long page by revealing each section as it enters the reader's local viewport.
items.descriptionZh: 用于长页逐段呈现，让读者滚到哪里就看到哪里，而不是一次塞满视野。
items.prompt:
Use scroll reveal / fade-in-up: when each content block becomes roughly 40% visible inside its own scroll container, animate from opacity 0 and translateY(16px) to rest in 240ms. Allow it to replay after leaving, and show the final state immediately under reduced motion.

FORBIDDEN: observing the window, fly-ins over 20px, combining blur/rotation/bounce, long stagger delays that withhold content, or keeping displacement under reduced motion.
items.promptZh:
请使用逐段揭示（Scroll Reveal / Fade-in-up）：每个内容块进入它所属滚动容器约 40% 可见区域时，从 opacity 0、translateY(16px) 在 240ms 内落到原位；离开后允许再次触发，reduced-motion 时直接显示最终态。

FORBIDDEN：监听整个 window、超过 20px 的飞入、同时使用 blur/旋转/弹跳、长串延迟导致内容不可读、reduced-motion 下仍保留位移。

items.name: Scroll Progress
items.description: Show readers how much of a long article, document, or contained flow remains.
items.descriptionZh: 用于长文、文档或局部流程，持续告诉读者已经读到哪里、还剩多少。
items.prompt:
Add local scroll progress / a reading indicator: place a 3–4px hairline bar at the top of the reading container, drive scaleX from 0 to 1 with that container's own scrollYProgress, and keep transform-origin on the left. Keep it visible without covering the copy.

FORBIDDEN: binding to window progress, animating width and causing layout work, fake percentages, oversized attention-grabbing bars, or filling before the reader reaches the end.
items.promptZh:
请添加局部滚动进度（Scroll Progress / Reading Indicator）：在阅读容器顶部放一条 3–4px 的细进度条，以容器自身的 scrollYProgress 驱动 scaleX 0→1，并把 transform-origin 固定在 left；进度条保持可见但不遮正文。

FORBIDDEN：绑定 window 进度、用 width 触发布局重排、显示虚假百分比、把进度条做成抢眼的大色块、到达底部前提前填满。

items.name: Horizontal Scroll
items.description: Turn a portfolio, timeline, or sequence of steps into a deliberate sideways narrative.
items.descriptionZh: 用于作品集、时间线或步骤序列，把纵向滚动转换成有节奏的横向叙事。
items.prompt:
Use a vertical-driven horizontal scroll gallery: inside a local scroll container with explicit height, keep the gallery viewport sticky at the top and map that container's 0→1 vertical progress from x=0% to about -62%. Keep the first and last cards fully reachable, and fall back to native horizontal scrolling under reduced motion.

FORBIDDEN: hijacking page scroll, swallowing trackpad horizontal gestures, moving body copy sideways, clipping the first or last card, or preserving automatic sideways travel under reduced motion.
items.promptZh:
请使用纵滚驱动横滚（Horizontal Scroll Gallery）：在一个有明确高度的局部滚动容器中，把画廊视口 sticky 在顶部，用容器自身 0→1 的纵向进度将卡片轨道从 x=0 映射到约 -62%；首尾卡必须完整可达，reduced-motion 时退化为原生横向滚动。

FORBIDDEN：劫持整页滚动、吞掉触控板横向手势、让正文一起横移、首尾卡被裁掉、reduced-motion 下继续自动横移。

items.name: Scroll Snap
items.description: Give a short product story or presentation-like sequence one decisive panel per gesture.
items.descriptionZh: 用于短篇产品故事或演示式序列，让一次滚动手势稳定落在一个完整面板。
items.prompt:
Use vertical scroll snap / paginated panels: set a local container to scroll-snap-type: y mandatory, make every panel at least one container-height tall, and align each with scroll-snap-align: start. Add overscroll-behavior: contain so snapping remains inside the device frame.

FORBIDDEN: mandatory snap on the body, inconsistent panel heights that stop halfway, hidden scrollbars, nested mandatory snap regions, or JavaScript that repeatedly fights native scrolling.
items.promptZh:
请使用纵向吸附滚动（Scroll Snap / Paginated Panels）：局部容器设为 scroll-snap-type: y mandatory，每个面板至少占满容器高度并以 scroll-snap-align: start 对齐；使用 overscroll-behavior: contain，把吸附限制在该设备画框内。

FORBIDDEN：把 body 设为 mandatory snap、面板高度不一致导致半截停留、隐藏滚动条、嵌套多层强制吸附、用 JavaScript 反复纠正原生滚动。

items.name: Scroll Zoom
items.description: Bring one key visual or product moment into focus as it reaches the center of a story.
items.descriptionZh: 让关键视觉或产品时刻在抵达叙事中心时获得焦点，适合单个重点内容登场。
items.prompt:
Use scroll zoom / scale-in: as the primary card enters from the bottom of its local scroll container and approaches center, map scale from 0.86 to 1 and opacity from 0.4 to 1. Keep the transform origin stable, do not displace surrounding content, and render at scale 1 under reduced motion.

FORBIDDEN: binding to page scroll, scaling beyond 1, perspective rotation, heavy simultaneous blur, layout shifts caused by scaling, or retained zoom under reduced motion.
items.promptZh:
请使用缩放入场（Scroll Zoom / Scale-in）：当主卡从局部滚动容器底部进入并靠近中心时，将 scale 从 0.86 映射到 1、opacity 从 0.4 映射到 1；缩放中心稳定，周围内容不位移，reduced-motion 直接显示 scale 1。

FORBIDDEN：绑定页面滚动、放大超过 1、透视旋转、同时大幅 blur、缩放引发布局跳动、reduced-motion 下保留缩放。

items.name: Stacking Cards
items.description: Close a card-led story by letting successive ideas collect into one visible stack.
items.descriptionZh: 用于卡片式叙事的收束，让连续观点逐张覆盖并最终汇成一个可见卡组。
items.prompt:
Use stacking cards / a sticky stack: keep four cards in normal flow, make each position: sticky, and increase top by about 20px per index so every layer leaves a readable edge. Compress later cards by only about 1.8%, then let the complete stack release naturally at the end.

FORBIDDEN: identical top values that fully hide earlier cards, fixed positioning, scaling over 5%, cards that remain pinned to the page forever, or heavy shadows that muddy the layers.
items.promptZh:
请使用叠层卡片（Stacking Cards / Sticky Stack）：四张卡依次放在正常文档流中，每张用 position: sticky，并让 top 按索引递增约 20px，形成清晰露边；越靠下的卡只做约 1.8% 的轻微缩放下压，最后自然释放整组。

FORBIDDEN：所有卡使用同一个 top 完全遮死、fixed 定位、超过 5% 的缩放、卡片永久留在页面上、用高强度阴影制造脏乱层级。

items.name: Navbar
items.description: The strip pinned across the very top of every page — brand mark, a handful of links, one way in.
items.descriptionZh: 贴在每个页面最顶端的一条窄带——品牌标志、几个链接、一个入口按钮。
items.prompt:
Structure = logo/brand + a handful of nav links + one primary action (login/CTA)
Semantics: wrap it in <nav>, keep it sticky so it survives scrolling
3-5 links max — anything more belongs in a mega menu, not the top bar
Collapse links into a hamburger on mobile; never let the row overflow
Exactly one solid button; demote everything else to plain text links
items.promptZh:
结构 = logo/品牌名 + 若干导航链接 + 一个主入口按钮(登录/CTA)
语义用 <nav> 包裹,通常做成 sticky,滚动后依然可见
链接数量控制在 3-5 个,更多内容应该收进二级菜单而不是塞满顶栏
移动端把链接收进汉堡菜单,不要让整行溢出换行
只保留一个实色按钮,其余全部降级为纯文字链接

fetch.value:
Structure = logo/brand + a handful of nav links + one primary action (login/CTA)
Semantics: wrap it in <nav>, keep it sticky so it survives scrolling
3-5 links max — anything more belongs in a mega menu, not the top bar
Collapse links into a hamburger on mobile; never let the row overflow
Exactly one solid button; demote everything else to plain text links

items.name: Hero
items.description: The opening block above the fold — one headline, one promise, one action. Most visitors never scroll past it.
items.descriptionZh: 首屏就是「开头那一大块」:一句主张、一个承诺、一个按钮。大多数访客的去留在这里决定。
items.prompt:
Structure = optional badge + headline + subline + primary/secondary buttons + optional trust note
Headline ≤2 lines, sells the outcome not the feature; the subline explains how in one sentence
Exactly one primary button, verb-first; demote the secondary to outline or text link
Headline at least 3x body size, fully visible above the fold
Semantics: <header> with the page's single <h1> living here
items.promptZh:
结构 = 徽章(可选)+ 主标题 + 副标题 + 主/次双按钮 + 信任小字(可选)
主标题 ≤2 行、说结果不说功能;副标题一句话补充「怎么做到」
主按钮只有一个,动词开头;次按钮弱化为描边或文字链接
标题字号至少 3 倍正文,首屏内完整可见(注意 fold 线)
语义用 <header>/<h1>,一页只有一个 h1,就在这里

fetch.value:
Structure = optional badge + headline + subline + primary/secondary buttons + optional trust note
Headline ≤2 lines, sells the outcome not the feature; the subline explains how in one sentence
Exactly one primary button, verb-first; demote the secondary to outline or text link
Headline at least 3x body size, fully visible above the fold
Semantics: <header> with the page's single <h1> living here

items.name: Logo Wall
items.description: A quiet row of customer logos right under the hero — no pitch, just proof that real companies already use this.
items.descriptionZh: 紧跟在首屏下方的一排客户 logo——不说一句推销话,只用「这些公司都在用」证明可信。
items.prompt:
Structure = optional caption line + one row of 5-7 logo wordmarks
Keep every logo the same grayscale treatment — no brand colors competing for attention
5-7 logos per row is the sweet spot; fewer looks thin, more feels cluttered
Place it immediately after the hero, before any feature explanation
Logos are decorative, not interactive — no hover states, no links needed in the demo
items.promptZh:
结构 = 可选的一句说明文字 + 一行 5-7 个 logo/wordmark
所有 logo 统一灰度处理,不要让品牌色互相抢镜
一行 5-7 个是黄金数量,太少显得单薄,太多显得拥挤
紧跟在 hero 之后出现,早于任何功能介绍
logo 是装饰性的,不需要可点击或悬停效果

fetch.value:
Structure = optional caption line + one row of 5-7 logo wordmarks
Keep every logo the same grayscale treatment — no brand colors competing for attention
5-7 logos per row is the sweet spot; fewer looks thin, more feels cluttered
Place it immediately after the hero, before any feature explanation
Logos are decorative, not interactive — no hover states, no links needed in the demo

items.name: Features
items.description: The block that answers 'okay, but what does it actually do' — a short list of the product's strongest selling points.
items.descriptionZh: 卖点区回答「它到底能干什么」——把产品最能打的几个卖点摆出来,一目了然。
items.prompt:
One card, one selling point — never merge two features into a single card
Titles sell the outcome (what the user gets), not the feature name (what the system does)
Keep icon style consistent within a group — same stroke weight and palette, don't mix filled and outline
3-6 selling points is the comfort zone; group or paginate past that
Wrap in <section>, with each card as its own list item
items.promptZh:
一卡一卖点,不要把两个功能塞进一张卡里
标题写收益(用户得到什么),不写功能名(系统做了什么)
同组图标风格要统一——同一描边粗细、同一色系,不要混搭实心/线性
3-6 个卖点是舒适区,超过 6 个考虑分组或分页
语义用 <section> 包裹,每张卡是一个独立的 <article> 或 <div> 列表项

fetch.value:
One card, one selling point — never merge two features into a single card
Titles sell the outcome (what the user gets), not the feature name (what the system does)
Keep icon style consistent within a group — same stroke weight and palette, don't mix filled and outline
3-6 selling points is the comfort zone; group or paginate past that
Wrap in <section>, with each card as its own list item

items.name: Stats
items.description: A short band of big numbers — users, uptime, ratings — that turns a claim into a fact at a glance.
items.descriptionZh: 一条由大号数字组成的窄带——用户数、可用性、评分——把一句话主张变成一眼可信的事实。
items.prompt:
Structure = 3-4 stat pairs, each a big number over a small label
Every number should be sourced/credible — no fabricated precision
Never exceed 4 stats; more than that dilutes which number matters
Number is always the largest text in the pair — label stays small and muted
Thin dividers between columns, no card backgrounds needed
items.promptZh:
结构 = 3-4 组「大数字+小标签」
每个数字都要有可信来源,不要编造精确到小数点的假数据
最多 4 个,超过这个数量就没人记得住哪个数字重要
数字永远是这一组里字号最大的,标签保持小号、弱化
列间用细线分隔即可,不需要额外的卡片背景

fetch.value:
Structure = 3-4 stat pairs, each a big number over a small label
Every number should be sourced/credible — no fabricated precision
Never exceed 4 stats; more than that dilutes which number matters
Number is always the largest text in the pair — label stays small and muted
Thin dividers between columns, no card backgrounds needed

items.name: Testimonials
items.description: Proof that real people already trust this product — quotes from customers, placed where doubt is highest.
items.descriptionZh: 用户评价区是「别听我说,听用户说」的地方——放在访客最容易犹豫的位置,用真实反馈打消疑虑。
items.prompt:
Real names and titles read far more credible than 'a happy user', even with just an initial avatar
Quotes should cite a concrete result (a number, a scenario) — never vague praise like 'works great'
Wrap quotes in <blockquote> and attribution in <figure>/<figcaption>
Keep avatar style consistent (all initials or all photos), never mixed
Don't stack near-duplicate praise — each quote should say something different
items.promptZh:
真实姓名 + 头衔远比匿名「某用户」可信,哪怕只是首字母头像
引言要具体到结果(数字、场景),不要写「很好用」这种空话
语义用 <blockquote> 包裹引言、<figure>/<figcaption> 包裹署名
头像统一风格(全用首字母圆形或全用图片),不要混搭
一屏不要塞超过一句话量级的重复夸奖,内容要有差异化

fetch.value:
Real names and titles read far more credible than 'a happy user', even with just an initial avatar
Quotes should cite a concrete result (a number, a scenario) — never vague praise like 'works great'
Wrap quotes in <blockquote> and attribution in <figure>/<figcaption>
Keep avatar style consistent (all initials or all photos), never mixed
Don't stack near-duplicate praise — each quote should say something different

items.name: Pricing
items.description: The pricing section — plan cards side by side, with one of them clearly the intended choice.
items.descriptionZh: 定价表就是「把价格摆出来讨论」的区块:几张方案卡并排,其中一档就是希望你选的那个。
items.prompt:
Structure = optional section title + N plan cards, each card = plan name + large price + feature list + button
The price is the largest text in the whole section; the list states differences from other tiers, not the full feature set
The recommended tier sits in the middle (anchoring effect), marked with a border highlight or a small top badge
Buttons are verb-first; solid for the recommended tier, outlined for the rest, to separate visual priority
A monthly/annual toggle is a common enhancement, not a requirement
items.promptZh:
结构 = 分段标题(可选)+ N 张方案卡,每卡 = 方案名 + 大字价格 + 功能清单 + 按钮
价格数字是全区块最大字号;清单只写与其他档的差异,不写全集
推荐档放中间(锚定效应),配描边高亮或顶部小徽标标注
按钮动词开头,推荐档实色、其余描边,拉开视觉优先级
年付/月付切换是常见增强,不是必需项

fetch.value:
Structure = optional section title + N plan cards, each card = plan name + large price + feature list + button
The price is the largest text in the whole section; the list states differences from other tiers, not the full feature set
The recommended tier sits in the middle (anchoring effect), marked with a border highlight or a small top badge
Buttons are verb-first; solid for the recommended tier, outlined for the rest, to separate visual priority
A monthly/annual toggle is a common enhancement, not a requirement

items.name: FAQ
items.description: The FAQ section — pre-answering objections before the reader has to ask, right before the final decision.
items.descriptionZh: 常见问题就是「提前替访客把疑虑说完」的区块,通常卡在决定购买前的最后一关。
items.prompt:
Structure = optional section title + N Q&A items, each = question + answer
Write questions in the visitor's own words ('Can I...', 'Do you support...'), not as feature bullets
Lead the answer with the conclusion, then add detail — don't make readers guess the answer
Place it after pricing and before the CTA, where doubts peak in the conversion path
Add FAQPage structured data when possible so search results can expand the Q&A directly
items.promptZh:
结构 = 分段标题(可选)+ N 条问答,每条 = 问题 + 回答
问题用访客的原话提问(「可以...吗」「支不支持...」),不要写成功能条目
回答先给结论句,再补充细节,不要让人读完还要猜答案
放在 pricing 之后、CTA 之前,这是转化路径上疑虑最集中的位置
有条件时补 FAQPage 结构化数据,搜索结果里能直接展开问答

items.name: CTA
items.description: The moment a page stops explaining and asks for the click — a headline that restates the value and one button.
items.descriptionZh: 页面停止解释、开口要求点击的那一刻——一句重申价值的标题,加一个按钮。
items.prompt:
Structure = headline restating the value + one primary button, nothing else
Appears 1-2 times per page — more than that and every CTA loses urgency
Copy reaffirms the outcome ('Start shipping faster'), never generic ('Click here')
Exactly one button — a second option just adds a decision to postpone
Pick banner for the page's final push, boxed for a mid-page nudge that doesn't interrupt reading
items.promptZh:
结构 = 一句重申价值的标题 + 一个主按钮,不需要更多元素
一个页面出现 1-2 次即可,太多次每一次都会失去紧迫感
文案要重申结果(如「现在就开始更快地交付」),而不是空洞的「点击这里」
只放一个按钮,第二个选项只会让用户多一个「以后再说」的借口
banner 适合放在页面结尾做最后一推,boxed 适合插在正文中段做轻量提醒

items.name: Footer

items.descriptionZh: 页脚是整页的收尾:站内导航、法律链接与最后的落款,访客读到这里说明已经认真看完了。
items.prompt:
Structure = optional brand/link-group area + divider + copyright row
Wrap the whole block in a semantic <footer>, not a plain div
Group links into at most 4 groups, each with a small heading and no more than 5 links
The copyright row must carry a year, kept current rather than hardcoded to launch day
The footer isn't a junk drawer — a link that doesn't fit any group is better left out
items.promptZh:
结构 = 品牌/链接分组区(可选)+ 分隔线 + 版权行
用语义 <footer> 标签包裹整个区块,而不是普通 div
链接最多分 4 组,每组配一个小标题,组内链接不超过 5 条
版权行必须带年份,年份要维护而不是硬编码成开站那年
页脚不是杂物抽屉——放不进任何分组的链接,宁可不放
